title: who is the prime minister of nepal?

messages.content: who is the prime minister of nepal?

Using general/current information, Balendra Shah is the current Prime Minister of Nepal. He assumed office on March 27, 2026, following a landslide victory for the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP). Shah, a structural engineer and former rapper, previously served as the mayor of Kathmandu and is the youngest Prime Minister in Nepal's history, taking office at the age of 35.

Based on the uploaded document, the document describes "EKALYA 2026", a premier multidisciplinary technical festival organized by Cosmos College of Management and Technology. It is jointly organized by the Information & Communication Technology Club (ICT), the Civil Engineering Student Society (CESS), and the Student Academic Association of Rising Architects (SAARA). The event aims to foster innovation, leadership, and ethical responsibility in engineering and management education by combining strong academic foundations with practical exposure.

The core purpose of EKALYA is to create a cross-disciplinary environment where students can apply theoretical knowledge to real-world technical challenges. Its objectives include interdisciplinary collaboration between ICT, Architecture, and Civil Engineering, skill amplification, industry integration through workshops, and cultural exchange.

The event will be held at Cosmos College of Management & Technology, Sitapaila, Kathmandu, on February 12, 13, and 14, 2026. The document also highlights past exhibition events like Cosmos Fest - 2025, featuring activities such as Quiz Mania by the ICT Club, bridge structure demonstrations and shake table simulations by Civil Engineering students, and scale models of temples and smart urban planning by SAARA students.

The document also serves as a "Letter For Sponsorship", explaining why EKALYA is important for Nepal's development by empowering students to prototype solutions for national challenges. It outlines various sponsorship benefits, including enhanced brand visibility, positive brand association, community impact, networking opportunities, and direct audience engagement, with different sponsorship packages (Platinum, Gold, Silver, Bronze) detailing their respective benefits and amounts.
